Getter/Setter for the states-slot

Source: R/getters_setters.R, R/trace.R
states.Rd

Works for trace-class.

Usage

states(object)

states(object) <- value

# S4 method for class 'trace'
states(object)

# S4 method for class 'trace'
states(object) <- value

Arguments

object

An instance of the trace-class.

value

Value with which to replace the original value of the states slot.

See also

trace-class

Examples

# Initialize trace
setting <- background(shape = rectangle(center = c(0, 0), size = c(5, 5)),
                      objects = list(circle(center = c(0, 0), radius = 1)))
my_trace <- trace(time_step = 0.5, 
                  setting = setting,
                  states = list(list()),
                  variables = list(list()))

# Access the states slot for the trace
states(my_trace)
#> [[1]]
#> list()
#> 

# Change the states slot for the agent
states(my_trace)[[1]] <- list(agent(center = c(-2, 0), radius = 0.25))
states(my_trace)
